cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Challenge by Proxy
cards.instruction: Persuade someone else to challenge a rule or authority before you risk doing it yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Will you challenge the captain's queue-jumping rule at tonight's club meeting?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He cancelled my booking last time I complained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Ask him to restore your booking as well. I'll draft both requests for your speech.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then sign it. I want him to know it's both of us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll leave space for my signature. Once he's agreed you have a point, call me up to add it.

mechanism: A coaches a pupil challenge to the captain while deferring its own named support until the challenge succeeds.
confusable: Not ordinary mentoring courage: A explicit delayed signature avoids risk until authority concedes.
comparison: Workplace doorway distance versus public club authorship withheld.
seedUse: D56 captain/booking/drafted requests/signature; S05 grades confrontation skills.
